assets.label: Curtains
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE individual transparent modular hairstyle sprite for a front-facing 3D avatar game.
Input images: Image 1 is the APPROVED design sheet. Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY the hairstyle from the top-left, 01 avatar, labeled "Curtains". Image 2 and Image 3 are existing production HAIR-ONLY sprites, showing exactly the expected isolation, genuine transparent face opening, matte charcoal material and broad sculpted locks.
Primary request: Create ONLY the Curtains HAIR OBJECT as one centered isolated asset on genuinely transparent alpha. Preserve its approved silhouette, fringe, parts and proportions. Short center-parted curtains with a clear center notch, two broad curved curtain sections sweeping outward above the eyebrows, compact sides and short narrow sideburns. Not a chin-length bob.
Style: softly sculpted matte charcoal-gray vinyl-toy 3D hair. Chunky smooth readable locks, broad restrained highlights, studio light upper left. Fixed straight-on orthographic front camera. Keep the reference grayscale shade, no color accents.
Important construction: Like images 2 and 3, this is a hollow front-view hairstyle overlay for an invisible round head. All spaces where the face, ears, neck and torso would be must be actual TRANSPARENT alpha, not charcoal filling. Only show real hair visible from the front, including side lengths and ponytail loops where they extend beyond the invisible head. Do not place an opaque back-of-head patch over the face opening. The crown and forehead fringe connect to the side sections naturally; preserve true transparent gaps between separated locks. The fringe ends above the eye region. No skin, forehead, ears, face, eyes, eyebrows, mouth, nose, scalp, mannequin, head, neck, torso, shirt, background, captions, numbers, grid, labels, props, glow, external cast shadows or checkerboard.
Composition: square asset canvas, one complete hairstyle centered, fully visible with generous transparent margin on all sides. Preserve the frontal camera and the approved style. Do not include any other hairstyles or the sheet.
